text:
ops-bot: @here Planned maintenance update: control-plane cert rotation + routing reconciliation in eu-west1. Window moved earlier by 30m — new window 2026-03-22 02:00–02:45 UTC. Expected behavior: short 1–3 minute latency spikes during router converge; no sustained request loss expected. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/controlplane-cert-rot

eli (oncall): ack — i'll be on the bridge for the whole window. posting statuspage + customer copy in a sec.

jin (sre): can we compress steps to keep the outage surface <30m? any blockers?

ops-bot: target duration 45m to be conservative: drain -> cert-swap -> router reload -> verify traffic. each step has timeout/rollback. see timeline in runbook.

michelle (pgm): preparing customer comms. plan to send targeted emails to affected customers at T-6h. will share draft here for review.

kyle (incident-bot): Pager test scheduled at 2026-03-22 01:45 UTC to verify oncall reachability. :bell:

eli (oncall): Statuspage draft: "We will perform maintenance on the control plane in eu-west1 at 02:00 UTC. During the maintenance window some requests may experience short latency spikes (~1–3 minutes) while routing caches reconcile. No sustained errors expected. We'll post updates here and on the status page." feedback?

michelle (pgm): LGTM. add: "If you require a maintenance-free window, contact support@redwood.ai" and an estimated impact note for Dedicated customers.

customer-ops: please include Dedicated customers in the email target (they run scheduled jobs). i'll prepare the recipient export.

jin (sre): confirmed — add tag "dedicated=true" to the export. i'll coordinate with sales-ops for any hand-schedule requests.

eli (oncall): oncall handoff plan: i'm primary, jin is secondary. escalation path: @sre-lead and phone +1-555-0102 if bridge duration >15m or error-rate >2%.

ops-bot: preflight checklist (condensed): 1) config backups ok 2) traffic throttling set 3) rollback artifact ready 4) alert thresholds verified. Quick commands:
```sh
# drain control-plane nodes in eu-west1
redwoodctl node drain --zone eu-west1 --wait 300
# roll certs (dry-run first)
redwoodctl cert rotate --zone eu-west1 --dry-run
```

michelle (pgm): sending draft to legal for a quick review now (ETA 45m).

customer-ops: thanks — i'll queue the email for T-6h pending legal.

ops-bot: NOTE: window moved earlier to accommodate infra maintenance. Will post statuspage update at T-3h and a reminder at T-5m. :information_source:

eli (oncall): during the window please watch these dashboards: control-plane-latency, routing-error-rate, and kv-cache-hit. ping here immediately if you see >2% sustained errors.

ops-bot: POST-MAINT: :white_check_mark: Maintenance complete. Observed a brief routing spike ~45s at 02:07 UTC; no customer-impacting errors detected. Actual window 02:02–02:18 UTC. If any teams saw >5m degraded behavior file ticket and we'll triage for a follow-up. Closing thread — great job everyone. :tada:
